sql.position.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.position, p.id as position_id, p.org_type_id, ot.org_type, p.archived, p.schedulable, p.available_to_children from flow.position p inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = p.org_type_id where ot.company_id = :companyId order by p.position
sql.position.getAllForCompanyWithParent: select p.id, p.position, p.id as position_id, p.org_type_id, ot.org_type, p.archived, p.schedulable, p.available_to_children from flow.position p inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = p.org_type_id where (ot.company_id = :companyId OR (ot.company_id = :parentCompanyId AND p.available_to_children is true)) order by p.position
sql.position.getOne: select p.id, p.position, p.org_type_id, ot.org_type, p.archived, p.schedulable, p.available_to_children, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(companyFeatures))) FROM ( select cf.id, cf.feature_name as "featureName", cf.company_id as "companyId", cf.feature_id as "featureId", cf.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(accessControl))) FROM ( select pfac.id, pfac.position_id as "positionId", pfac.company_feature_id as "companyFeatureId", ac.id as "accessControlId", ac.access_level as "accessLevel", ac.access_code as "accessCode", pfac.enabled from flow.access_control ac left join flow.position_feature_access_control pfac on ac.id = pfac.access_control_id and pfac.company_feature_id = cf.id and pfac.position_id = p.id order by ac.display_order ) accessControl), '[]') AS "accessControl" from flow.company_feature cf where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true order by cf.feature_name ) companyFeatures), '[]') AS "companyFeatures" from flow.position p inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = p.org_type_id where p.id = :id
sql.position.insert: insert into flow.position(company_id, position, org_type_id, created_by_id, schedulable, available_to_children) values (:companyId, :position, :orgTypeId, :createdById, :schedulable, :availableToChildren)
sql.position.update: update flow.position set position = :position, org_type_id = :orgTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, schedulable = :schedulable, available_to_children = :availableToChildren, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.position.delete: update flow.position set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.position.insertPositionFeatureAccessCont: insert into flow.position_feature_access_control(company_feature_id, access_control_id, position_id, enabled) values (:companyFeatureId, :accessControlId, :positionId, true);
sql.position.updatePositionFeatureAccessCont: update flow.position_feature_access_control set enabled = :enabled where id = :positionFeatureAccessControlId
